name: Enemy
overview: Scripture reveals a complex relationship with enemies, emphasizing both justice and mercy. For instance, Exodus 23:5 commands helping even those who hate us, reflecting a call to compassionate action despite animosity. Job 31:29-30 highlights the righteousness in refraining from rejoicing over an enemy's downfall or cursing them. Meanwhile, Psalms 9:3 and 35:1 express trust in God to defend against adversaries, showing reliance on divine justice rather than personal vengeance. Together, these verses teach believers to balance love and forgiveness with a confident hope in God's righteous judgment.
